verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll/PEO product, so year-end W-2 and 1099 generation and distribution is an applicable axis. The evidence pack never documents producing or delivering these forms. The nearest items are adjacent: W-4 data collection at enrollment, quarterly payroll-accuracy checks, and recording off-platform payments. None of these show automated W-2 or 1099 generation or distribution to workers.
